note: Physical acceptance state for the Froemix base board, euro board and panel. An item moves to "accepted" only with measured evidence in doc/evidence/ that names a reviewer, a date, at least one value with a unit, and the current hardware fingerprint. The fingerprint covers both boards' entry files, sections/ and lib/ trees, the panel and CAD algorithms, the packages and lock files, the JLCPCB order settings and the curated sourcing/part maps, so any hardware, algorithm, order-setting or part-selection change makes old evidence stale. Refresh hardware_fingerprint with `bun tools/release/gate.ts --fingerprint` after such a change; a documentation-only commit does not change it. There is no override, force, skip or waive key: unknown keys are errors. Every item is pending because no bench measurement has been recorded. See doc/acceptance.md.

items.note: Assembled base + euro board pair: 11 mm clear spacers, header shoulder and post contact engagement, front-board rear tails <= 1 mm and J1 + shunts <= 9.5 mm, with the installed depth measured.
Both 1x20 female Daisy sockets fitted: exact part identity, installed height, insert/remove force, clearance to the euro board and rack, and USB access with the Daisy seated.

The real screw-head and washer MPNs and their measured head/washer OD, with clearance to C25, CN1 and the J2 courtyard recorded; the 5 mm OD limit is a requirement until the actual hardware is measured.
NAV actuator reach through the panel, tilt/travel, retention and return force measured on the printed part and the fitted switch.
MODE switch travel, preload, actuation force, cap fit and panel hole clearance measured on the real switch and cap.
Jack and pot bushing thread, panel hole fit, nut/washer seating and knob fit measured on the real parts, including the 3.5 mm jack nose length.
20HP panel in a real 3U rack: rail engagement, screw positions, panel flatness and clearance to neighbouring modules measured.
OLED module identity, standoff height, window alignment, flex-cable path and clearance to U16 measured with the module fitted.

Every hand-soldered part and loose hardware item identified by an approved EU supplier (RS Components, Electrokit or DigiKey with EU sales) and the exact MPN; no LCSC reference number treated as an approved source.
P5V loaded measurement <= 300 mA, start-up and load-step transients, and U16 temperature at the recorded ambient and worst-case load.
CV in and CV out calibrated against a reference at the recorded points, with the firmware DAC output buffer confirmed DISABLED (unbuffered 0..VDDA) on the built unit.
CV out full-scale step and sine response with <= 10 nF cable/load capacitance per output, with overshoot and settle time recorded.
U1 mux and the sync input in every power order: powered, unpowered and back-fed, with no damage, latch-up or current into an unpowered rail, recorded per rail order.
Receiver threshold against the CA-033 receiver requirement, high-current input current and fault temperature measured at the recorded supply and ambient.

Transmitter current into legacy receiver loads, rise/fall edges and sustained ring/tip fault temperatures measured; CA-033 compliance is not inferred from a receiver-only calculation. The STM32H750 GPIO absolute limits and reset state must also be verified against a primary ST datasheet: the 20 mA per-pin limit, VOL 0.4 V, VOH and the reset state are explicit assumptions today, and a bench current measurement alone cannot prove an absolute rating.
The single-point ground-to-chassis scheme decided and measured: tie point, tie resistance and the rack/chassis connection recorded.
ESD test on every exposed jack, panel opening and connector, with the applied level, the observed result and the protection parts recorded.
DFM/CPL review of the exported gerbers, BOM and JLCPCB placement preview for the base board, the euro board and the panel, with findings recorded before any order.
First-article boards and panel built, inspected and measured against the full acceptance list before any production order.
